description: This file is a shell script that appears to be a test suite for interacting with a Perforce (p4) version control system and Git, specifically testing the 'git p4' integration for various depot view mappings, file operations, and synchronization behaviors. It includes functions for verifying files, setting up depot structures, performing clone and submit operations, and running numerous detailed test cases to validate mapping precedence, wildcards, exclusions, overlays, renames, quoting, and synchronization correctness.

methods.name: check_files_exist
methods.description: Verifies that all listed files exist exactly, matching the 'files' list.

methods.name: client_verify
methods.description: Navigates into the specified client directory, runs 'p4 sync', and checks for the existence of specified files.

methods.name: git_verify
methods.description: Checks that the specified files exist in the git repository working directory.
